Full summary: Phase 1 execution started on branch dashboard-scale-redesign (subagent-driven). Task 1 (seed-scale-fixture.ts + seed:scale npm script) implemented by subagent, verified at 5k scale; review subagent running now, commit follows review approval.
Decisions: Chose a feature branch (dashboard-scale-redesign) over committing the redesign directly to main — multi-day 17-task execution should keep main releasable; the npm tag-based release flow pulls from main.; Chose controller-commits with working-tree review packages over subagent commits — memory note: subagent commits race the pre-commit hook transcript flush; consequence discovered: the skill's review-package script needs commits, so review diffs are built manually from git diff HEAD + untracked file contents.
Findings: Discovered need (from Task 1 subagent): DecisionStore.create() throws ENOENT unless decisions/index.json pre-exists — bare mkdirSync is insufficient; fixture uses src/storage/init.ts initTwiningDir(). DecisionStore lacks GraphStore's defensive ensureFiles() pattern — future hardening candidate, out of scope here.; Task 1 verification: 5k seed run 54s, 5000 bb lines / 5001 decision files / 5000 entities / 7998 relations, 18mo spread, 7.6% superseded; npm test 1114 passed / 2 skipped; tsc clean. Note scripts/ is outside tsconfig include — standalone tsc check needed matching flags.
